name: save_says_what_it_replaced
why: REPORT 8CD843 N55 (round 14, 27/10/2026). save_document with a «path» wrote over a file that existed (363440 bytes, written minutes before) and answered only the new size. There it was wanted; on a real file the work before is lost with no word.
_how_the_existing_file_is_made_sure: The bench folder keeps the files of the run before, so the second save may or may not find one. The third does for certain: it goes back onto the file of the first save, which is no longer the document's own after the second.
defect_caught: A save onto another existing file that does not say so: «replaced_another_file» must be true, with the size of what was there.

expect.why: any part: the case is about the file
the first file, the one the third save goes back onto
now the document's own file is the second one
the first file is there and is not the document's own: the answer must say it was replaced
and how to be refused instead
